The Water Queen's House is a Location within the Lower City in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3.
“
Queen Umberlee, the sea Herself,

I dash myself upon the rocks of your favour,
Let me drink the brine of your glory deep into my lungs,
Turn my skull to shell, my ribs to reef,
To earn your blessing,

And to spare me the wrath of your sahuagin.
„
— Supplications to Umberlee

Overview

The Water Queen's House is a temple dedicated to the deity  Queen Umberlee. It is a huge building in the southmost part of the Grey Harbour Docks, standing on a rocky cape pushing far into the waters of the River Chionthar.

The temple consists of two parts: the portico lined up with a colonnade, used for offering and worship by commoners, with a fountain depicting The Bitch Queen[1] herself in the middle, and the actual two-storied building with a cellar in the rocky foot of the cape, used by the clergy. It has only one way of entering through the portico at X: -228 Y: -201. The cellar of the temple is accessible through the passageway in the backside of the cliff at X: -254 Y: -265.

Umberlee's followers ("Umberlants" as official term, and "waveservants", by the common speaking) in Baldur's Gate are led by  Flood Tide Allandra Grey.[2] Being a huge trading port, Baldur's Gate obviously has a fair share of Umberlee worshippers, notably the sailors and sea captains, who fear the wrath of Umberlee in their travels and seek her favour. Umberlee's clergy, though, care not only for spreading the influence of their goddess, but also of material basis for doing so, covertly accumulating wealth and taking into possession the city's docks and shipyards.[3]

Building layout

Portico entrance

The portico gallery encircles the aforementioned fountain and serves to the commoner worshippers of the Sea Queen. It features an altar for those who want to pray at X: -222 Y: -223. Several worshippers are in this area, praying, discussing the donations, or simply fancying the sea sights.

An Offerings Chest for donations is on the opposite side at X: -233 Y: -226, guarded by  Seawind Star Stolitti, one of Umberlee's waveservants. Another waveservant can be occasionally seen emptying the chest, as she moves the contents to the temple cellar treasury. Party members placing any item or any amount of gold in the Offering Chest receive Umberlee's  blessing until their next Long Rest. However, this can only be done once per party member and does not stack with other instances of Bless, such as  Sweet Stone Features. It is removed if the character respecs.

Interacting with the chest is not a crime, but taking any of the items out of the chest is. Stealing from the chest (or from the treasure pile in the Water Queen's Cellar (see below) angers Umberlee, causing her to cease blessing future party member donations (existing ones are not cancelled).

Donating to the chest grants the ⁠Offerings to the Waves inspiration to characters with the  Acolyte background.

Following the way underneath an archway brings the party to the main building.

The southwestern corner of the portico approximately at X: -240 Y: -202 can be used to access the Steel Watch Foundry territory through a series of jumps (spells like  Misty Step or  Feather Fall help to avoid falling damage).

Main building

In the separate nave at the back of the temple the head priestess Allandra Grey is leading a funeral ceremony for the deceased  Holli Dylford – her body lies on the mat in the centre, and several waveservants are chanting a song of lamentation.

To the west a short stairway lead down to a kitchen area where two Untaken (i.e., novice clerics) are preparing drinks and food for the funeral. Some Camp Supplies and the book  Sacred Shark Recipes are in the area.

To the east, a stairway leads up to the first floor of the temple, while to the south another leads outside the temple onto a balcony and then to a small beach patch, where there is a passage to the temple cellar.

Upper floor

The upper floor consists of an entry office room and Allandra Grey's private quarters, connected with a bridge seen from the outside. Inside the entry room  Vilmina stands guard, blocking further passage. Several containers here are not locked, but red-outlined:

  • A Traveller's Chest and a small Gilded Chest on a desk at X: -213 Y: -245 contain gold, alchemical ingredients, and random precious gem.
  • Two Opulent Chests keep gold, random precious gems, and (possibly) Valuables, random spell scrolls and / or potions.

Through the door and across the archway is another room. Inside is  Norya Baker who accuses the party of trespassing if she spots them here. On the wall is a fishing net decorated with lootable  Starfishes and  Pearls. At the far end of the room is an Opulent Chest containing the  High Security Vault nº4 Key and the  Wavemother's Cloak.

Southern exit

To the south of the temple a small stairway leads down. At X: -245 Y: -277 a  DC 20 Survival Check highlights a buried chest containing a Rare arrow, a health potion ( Greater or  Superior), and a random book. On the beach three fishers chat about possibly catching a  Sahuagin and what that might entail.

Going past the group, a passageway can be spotted inside the rocks which leads to the Water Queen's Cellar.

Water Queen's Cellar

“
You dare steal from the very sea that birthed you? Enjoy these breaths - they shall be your last.
„
— Umberlee, when looting her treasure

The Water Queen's Cellar is a cave located underneath the Water Queen's House. It can be accessed through a passageway at X: -254 Y: -265 from an aforementioned patch of sandy beach behind the temple.

The cellar is considered a private area of the  Church of Umberlee and cannot be explored without trespassing; the use of stealth is recommended. When the party enter the area they must pass a water stream, from which a stairway leads up and further into the cellar. As the  Deep Water effectively breaks  invisibility, this might be an obstacle to an unhindered exploration of the cave.

Several Umberlants standing on the stairs and next to a table on the higher ground are discussing the recent death of Holli Dylford and apparently preparing a funeral repast, with a dead  Kuo-Toa served as food. Next to the table is an unlocked chest with minor random loot.

Treasure room

The back of the cellar is separated with an unlocked iron gate. Behind it is a room with a treasure pile containing  ~400 gp, a random gem, several pieces of jewelry, a bottle of wine and a  Fish. Looting the pile earns the  Wavemother's ire, triggering an  Ice Storm upon the party, summoning hostile  Sahuagin in the water pool further in the back and turning all the Waveservants in the cellar hostile (the clergy of the temple above do not turn hostile if the party pillage the cellar). Also, stealing Umberlee's donations here ends the party's ability to get  blessed when making an offering at the Offering Chest in the Water Queen's House.

In the far corner are another three dead Kuo-Toa. The corpse of  Redhammer is here if the party sided with the Church of Umberlee and handed him over to Allandra Grey as part of the ⁠Avenge the Drowned quest.

Hidden cavern

At X: -1840 Y: -78 in the far end of the cellar passing a  DC 15 Perception Check reveals a nearby Sandstone Wall which can be breached. Behind it is another small room with waterfalls and a Wooden Chest containing gold, random valuables, and some alchemical ingredients and / or elixirs.

Involvement

Upon the party's approaching the temple,  Diomira Trellis starts a conversation. She relates that the funeral of one of recently deceased waveservant is underway and allows them to enter regardless of their answer; the ceremony itself can be found in the main building.

Speaking with Allandra Grey allows the party to learn about the fate of deceased Holli Dylford. The priestess also ask the party of their offerings to the funeral ceremony. Choosing any answer except "I brought nothing" grants one or both of the following inspirations:

  • ⁠Offerings to the Waves ( Acolyte background)[4]
  • ⁠Sea Memorial ( Entertainer background)

When speaking of the offerings to the funeral, Cleric characters can use either the generic class line or the line reflecting their particular deity.[5] Monks and Barbarians also have unique lines. The aforementioned inspiration (if available) is granted regardless. The full list of possible formulations is on Allandra's page.

If the party agree to investigate Holli's death, the quest ⁠Avenge the Drowned is started. It can only be initiated if the party has not yet visited the Iron Throne. Holli can be communed with using  Speak with Dead. Also, Allandra mentions the sailors who caught Holli's body in their fishing nets. They are  Gowlan and  Fleer, who are near the docks waypoint.

Refusing to help Allandra find Holli's murderer is considered an oathbreaking action for Vengeance Paladins if they are the one interacting with the priestess.

If the party successfully finish the quest and sides with the waveservants, Allandra Grey moves up to her office. In this case, party members can get to her office without being stopped by the guards.

Notes and references

  1. ↑ One of the official titles of Umberlee, along with the "Wavemother", the "Queen of the Depths", and the "Stormgoddess of the Seas".
  2. ↑ All followers of the Water Queen in the game bear the actual titles used in the  Church of Umberlee according to the Forgotten Realms lore, though their ranking order is somewhat confused. For example, the "Untaken" is the common title for novices of the church, while the "Dark Breakers" and "Flood Tides" belong to the middle level in the table of ranks, and the "Savage Seawinds" are considered the senior clerics. Despite this, within the Baldur's Gate 3 plot Allandra Grey acts as the acknowledged leader of the temple and of the Umberlee's clergy.
  3. ↑ According to  Acquisitions journal.
  4. ↑ This is another option to earn the inspiration if it was not obtained through donating to the chest in the portico gallery. If the party member gets the inspiration from speaking with Allandra, Umberlee's blessing is not granted, though both the blessing and the inspiration can be obtained separately.
  5. ↑ Allandra responds to these with a specific line for most deities and also has a unique answer for clerics of  Mielikki and  Talos, calling either "another of the First Circle".
  6. ↑ Though it is not mentioned in the game, Holli had the title of a Seawind and has the correspondent archetype within the game files.
  7. ↑ Can be outside or in the cellar when bringing donations from the Offering Chest in the Water Queen's House to the cellar.
  8. ↑ His body is in the temple's cellar if he was surrendered to Allandra Grey in the end of ⁠Avenge the Drowned quest.
  9. ↑ Carried by by Allandra Grey
  10. ↑ In the mailbox of Vonayn's Home in Lower City X: 52 Y: -118.
